vuln_ground_truth.title: Unfair Rent Distribution in order_vault
vuln_ground_truth.description: The order_vault account's source_ta token account holds a rent-exempt reserve funded by the maker when creating an order. However, upon closing the order, the rent from this account is transferred to the taker regardless of who funded it. This occurs due to incorrect logic in the `return_rent` function, which calculates and transfers excess rent without considering the original funder. An attacker could exploit this by repeatedly taking expired or canceled orders to collect rent paid by makers. The impact is a loss of SOL for makers, though limited to rent amounts, resulting in unfair economic behavior and erosion of trust in the system.

results.reasoning: The contract has two access control vulnerabilities (CWE-284). First, the `owner` account passed in the SellNftTokenPool instruction is not verified to be the owner of the pool. This allows an attacker to specify a different owner and potentially steal the NFT and funds. Second, the `rent_payer` account is not constrained to match the stored rent payer in the pool, which could lead to rent being stolen or misappropriated.

findings.title: Missing Owner Verification in Pool Sale
findings.description: The `owner` account passed to the SellNftTokenPool instruction is not verified to be the owner of the pool. This allows an attacker to specify a different owner, leading to unauthorized transfers of the NFT and funds.

findings.title: Missing Rent Payer Verification in Pool Sale
findings.description: The `rent_payer` account passed to the instruction is not constrained to match the stored rent payer in the pool. This could allow an attacker to specify a different rent payer and potentially steal rent or cause unintended side effects when closing the pool.
